evaluation_protocol.test_policy: unique rows at supplied Day-8 arbitrary timestamps; no test feedback
evaluation_protocol.primary_metric: macro mean Shapiro-Wilk W across 3 series x 4 equally weighted targets
evaluation_protocol.aggregation_rationale: test each orbit series separately to avoid mixing distributions, then macro-average all 12 per-series/per-target Shapiro-Wilk evaluations
